setup.title: Set up HANJING Order Manager
setup.intro: Create the owner account. You need the setup code shown in the server log when the app was installed.
setup.setupCodeHint: Shown in the server log, e.g. ABCD-EFGH-JKLM.
setup.usernameHint: You will use it to sign in. Letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
setup.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back to HANJING Order Manager.
signIn.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask the person who manages the server to reset it.

security.title: Security
security.description: Password, signed-in devices and sign-in history

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Company name, currencies and session timeout

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Create, find and follow every order

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.description: Sellers in China and what they supplied

connection.offline: You're offline. Screens you opened before still work; saving needs a connection.
connection.unreachable: Can't reach the server. Check your connection or VPN — we'll retry automatically.

password.success: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
password.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.description: Sign out any device you don't recognise or no longer use.

reason.account_blocked: Too many failed attempts on this account
reason.ip_blocked: Too many failed attempts from this network

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every sign-in and change: who made it, when and from which device. Entries can't be edited or deleted.

action.user.signed_out_everywhere: Signed out everywhere by the Owner

company.title: Company
company.name: Company name
company.nameHint: Shown at the top of every screen. Any language.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: All profit and totals are calculated in the base currency. It cannot be changed.

session.title: Sign-in session
session.description: Devices that stay unused this long are signed out automatically.

orderNumbers.title: Order numbers
orderNumbers.hint: 1 to 10 letters, digits or dashes. Applies to new orders only.

rates.title: Exchange rates

providerHelp.currency_api: Free, no key. Daily rates, also for past dates.
providerHelp.exchangerate_api_open: Free, no key. Latest rates only; its attribution is shown with its rates.
providerHelp.manual: No automatic rates: every rate is typed by hand.

rates.apiKeyHelp: Only for providers that need one. It stays on the server and is never shown again.
rates.apiKeySet: A key is saved (ends with {{last4}}). Type a new one to replace it.
rates.autoFillHelp: On a new expense or payment, the rates are filled for its date. You can always change them.
rates.lastError: The last attempt failed ({{date}}). Rates can still be typed by hand.

categories.title: Expense categories
categories.description: Default categories follow each user's language. Hidden categories are no longer offered but stay on existing expenses.

payments.title: Payments
payments.channelNameHint: Leave empty to use the default name in each language.
payments.defaultPlanHint: Given to every new order. Each order's plan can then be changed on its own.
payments.banksHint: Offered in the bank's rate of a payment. Removing a bank never changes past payments.

registration.label: New workers may register
registration.hint: When off, the Register link disappears from the sign-in screen and new registrations are refused.

comingSoon.body: This section will be available in a coming update.

addressBook.name: Name
addressBook.deleteBody: It disappears from lists and search. You can restore it later.

orders.differenceHint: Agreed price minus items total. For information only.

form.title: Title
form.titleHint: e.g. 2 Doosan excavators for MJTR Gold
form.agreedPriceHint: The price agreed with the customer, typed by hand.
form.budgetHint: Optional: the total cost you plan for this order.
form.agreedRateHint: The rate agreed with the customer, used to compute profit in CNY.

items.title: Equipment
items.readOnly: Prices are not shown to you, so the item lines cannot be changed here.

list.empty: No orders yet. Create the first one.

notes.label: New note
notes.confirmBody: It disappears from this order. The deletion stays in the audit log.

delete.title: Delete this order?
delete.body: It disappears from lists and search. You can restore it from the deleted orders.

financials.title: Costs and profit (CNY)
financials.setAgreedRate: Set the agreed rate to see profit

close.title: Close this order?
close.body: {{amount}} is still to collect on this order.

assignees.title: Assigned workers
assignees.none: No worker is assigned to this order.

expenses.empty: No expenses yet. Add the first cost of this order.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: e.g. Trucking Linyi to Qingdao port
form.advancedByHint: Who paid with their own money, to reimburse later.

delete.title: Delete this expense?
delete.body: It leaves the totals and the profit. You can restore it from the deleted expenses.

rates.notExact: No rate was published for that date: this is the latest rate, of {{date}}.
rates.manualOnly: Automatic rates are off: type the rate.
rates.typoWarning: This is far from the latest rate (1 {{currency}} = {{rate}} CNY). Check it before saving.

reimbursements.title: To reimburse
reimbursements.description: Money people advanced from their own pocket, still owed to them.
reimbursements.nothingOwed: Nothing is owed to this person.
reimbursements.partial: Covers only the orders and entries you can see.

form.referenceHint: e.g. the transfer or receipt number

bank.title: Bank conversion
bank.name: Bank
bank.at: Date and time of the rate

compare.title: {{currency}}/CNY rates
compare.noMarket: No market rate known for this date: the gap cannot be shown.

warnings.overpaid: Payments exceed the agreed price by {{amount}}.
warnings.bankOverInvoice: Bank payments exceed the invoice total by {{amount}}.

delete.title: Delete this payment?
delete.body: It leaves the totals. You can restore it from the deleted payments.

access.deniedBody: Your account doesn't give you access to this page. Ask the Owner if you need it.

groupHint.sellingPrice: Agreed price, item prices, budget, profit and margin. Also hides what remains to collect, % paid and planned amounts.
groupHint.supplierPrices: Amounts of equipment purchases and of expenses paid to a supplier. Also hides total expenses, profit and margin.
groupHint.supplierIdentity: Which supplier sold an item or was paid. Also removes the Suppliers list.
groupHint.paymentAmounts: Payment amounts, rates and proofs. Also hides received, remaining, % paid, profit and margin.
groupHint.bankDetails: The bank named on a payment; later, the bank accounts on invoices.

conflict.orders_create_needs_prices: Creating orders needs the selling price visible.
conflict.payments_write_needs_amounts: Recording or editing payments needs payment amounts visible.
conflict.suppliers_need_identity: The Suppliers module needs supplier identity visible.

register.title: Register
register.intro: Create your account. The Owner approves it before you can sign in.
register.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
register.doneBody: Your account is created. The Owner will approve it; you can then sign in with your username and password.
register.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

users.title: Users
users.empty: No workers yet. New workers register from the sign-in screen.
users.rejectBody: This account will never be able to sign in. The username becomes free again.
users.adjustLater: You can adjust this worker's permissions on their page at any time.
users.accessSaved: Access saved. It applies from the worker's next action.

editor.hiddenHint: The worker never sees or receives these values, nor anything computed from them.

scope.title: Which orders
scope.ownEntries: Only the expenses and payments they recorded themselves
scope.ownEntriesHint: Totals then cover their own entries only.
scope.endsOnHint: Access stops at the end of this day, China time. Leave empty for no end.

templates.title: Role templates
templates.hint: A template fills in a worker's access when you approve them. Changing a template does not change workers already set up.
templates.name: Name
templates.defaultNameHint: Leave empty to keep the default name, "{{name}}", in every language.
templates.deleteBody: Workers set up with it keep their access.

assigned.title: Assigned orders
assigned.notUsed: These apply when the worker's scope is "Assigned orders only".

account.title: Account
account.suspendBody: Their devices are signed out at once and they cannot sign in until you reactivate them. Their permissions are kept.
account.signOutBody: Every device of this worker must sign in again.
account.deleteBody: They can never sign in again and their username is never reused. Their records keep their name. To stop access for a while, suspend them instead.
account.temporaryHint: At least 10 characters. Give it to the worker: they choose their own at their next sign-in, and their devices are signed out now.
account.passwordReset: Temporary password set. The worker's devices were signed out.

changePassword.title: Choose your password
changePassword.intro: The Owner set a temporary password for you. Choose your own to continue.
